interpretation.text: A single outlier in feature_x and feature_y (3.33% of values) could stem from data entry errors, measurement glitches, or genuine extreme cases; further domain review is needed.
Feature_x and feature_y are perfectly correlated (r = 1.0), indicating they provide duplicate information, which may be redundant or reflect leakage from the data generation process.
Because the analysis is based on only 30 observations, both the outlier detection and the perfect correlation are sensitive to a few points, so conclusions should be made cautiously.

next_steps: Examine the specific rows flagged as outliers in feature_x and feature_y.
Consult domain experts to verify whether the extreme values are plausible.
Consider applying robust scaling or capping if the outliers are deemed problematic.
Investigate how feature_x and feature_y were generated to understand their perfect correlation.
Test model performance with and without one of the correlated features.
Document any preprocessing decisions regarding outliers and correlated features.
